body.heading: Where in the world is Papua New Guinea?
paragraphs: Papua New Guinea is a country in Melanesia, which is part of Oceania.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Papua New Guinea is Port Moresby.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: People in Papua New Guinea speak Tok Pisin and English. Tok Pisin began as a trade language. Papua New Guinea has more languages than any other country on Earth — over 800 of them!

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Papua New Guinea is the Papua New Guinean kina.

body.heading: How big is Papua New Guinea?
paragraphs: Papua New Guinea covers about 463,000 square kilometres of land and inland water.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: The Kokoda Track crosses the Owen Stanley mountains on a famous wartime trail; in the capital, Port Moresby Nature Park shows the country's birds of paradise up close.
The mighty Sepik winds through lowland villages famed for spirit houses and some of the world's most striking traditional art and carving.
